title: Aquarius — The Stars Are Warning You
script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Jupiter is charging into Leo and flooding your 7th House of Partnerships with expansive fire, activating new bonds of love and collaboration. Saturn is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Uranus in your 1st House of Identity, and as an Air sign this creates friction between your need for freedom and your hunger for deep connection. If you're single, this transit supercharges your natural magnetism — show up to gatherings with unapologetic confidence and attract someone extraordinary. If taken, watch for financial tensions around shared resources; communicate honestly with your partner before assumptions take over. Saturn sits heavy on your 10th House of Public Status, demanding one decisive bold career move before the month of August ends. An unexpected blessing arrives through a quiet conversation you'll have tonight. Subscribe and follow for tomorrow's reading.
